description: This file implements the core logic for certificate verification in Chromium, including path building, trust store management, revocation checking, and EV certificate handling.

classes.name: CertVerifyProcTrustStore
classes.description: Wraps a SystemTrustStore with additional trust anchors and test roots for trust management during certificate verification.

classes.name: PathBuilderDelegateDataImpl
classes.description: Holds delegate data for path building, including OCSP verification results.

classes.name: PathBuilderDelegateImpl
classes.description: Implements path building delegate, handling revocation checks, EV policy conformance, and other path validation policies.

classes.name: CertVerifyProcBuiltin
classes.description: Main class implementing certificate verification using built-in path building, trust store, and revocation logic.

methods.name: ParseCertificateFromBuffer
methods.description: Parses a certificate from a buffer into a ParsedCertificate object.

methods.name: AddIntermediatesToIssuerSource
methods.description: Adds intermediate certificates from a chain to an issuer source.

methods.name: AppendPublicKeyHashes
methods.description: Calculates and appends SHA256 hashes of public key info from certificates or paths.

methods.name: MapPathBuilderErrorsToCertStatus
methods.description: Maps path building errors to certificate status flags.

methods.name: CreateVerifiedCertChain
methods.description: Constructs a verified certificate chain from path builder results.

methods.name: TryBuildPath
methods.description: Attempts to build a certificate path with specified parameters.

methods.name: AssignVerifyResult
methods.description: Assigns verification results, including errors and chain, to output structures.

methods.name: CanTryAgainWithWeakerDigestPolicy
methods.description: Determines if retrying with weaker signature algorithms might succeed.

methods.name: VerifyInternal
methods.description: Performs the core certificate verification process, including path building and revocation checks.
